sophie_fin: Quick flag from CarbonGrid on INV-2026-999 — customer says their support tier was billed at Premium instead of Standard for the renewal period, resulting in a $7,200 overcharge. cc @diego_acct

diego_acct: Pulling SOW and billing history. SOW-2023-88 lists SUPPORT_STANDARD annually. I see an invoice note: support_tier_override=PREMIUM applied by billing-job-2026-03-29.

sophie_fin: Customer is threatening to delay payment. Recommend provisional credit for the $7,200 overcharge while we reconcile. Any objections?

alan_controller: Approve provisional credit up to $8k for customer retention, require audit trail and ticket link on the credit memo. Controller note: "provisional - pending PRICING-472 reconciliation".

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-420 for $7,200, status pending_controller_approval. Attached invoice INV-2026-999 and migration log.

diego_acct: Draft customer message:

"""
Hi CarbonGrid team,

Thanks for flagging INV-2026-999. We identified an internal migration that incorrectly set your support tier to Premium. We're issuing a provisional credit of $7,200 while we complete the reconciliation and will send an adjusted invoice within 48 hours. Apologies for the disruption.

Best, Diego (Accounts)
"""

pricing-bot: Recommended action for engineering: prevent MIG-2026-03-supports from overwriting explicit SOW values; add test to ensure legacy_tier_code lookup falls back safely. Assign PRICING-472 to eng-pricing.

sophie_fin: Noting this thread for audit. Follow-up: confirm CM-2026-420 applied and PRICING-472 closed before finalizing.
